purpose: Teach: 勤勉/トラベル/平易/気概/描ける/むい/夏目/偶像

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「勤勉が美徳」と仰った
lines.en: Dear, when I was young, my father used to say that diligence is a virtue.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening; voice dropping into memory, gentle weight on his father's words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、二人でトラベル雑誌を集めたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and when we were young, we collected travel magazines together, didn't we, dear?
lines.style: Soft affirming hum first; tender rising warmth, the tag question lingering with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「平易な日本語が大事」と仰った
lines.en: Dear, when I was young, my father insisted that plain, simple Japanese is what matters.
lines.style: Contemplative and deliberate; a small pause before the quote, each word placed like a bookmark.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、起業の気概を貫かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you held fast to that spirit of building something of your own, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle pride swelling mid-line; slow and admiring, the closing question soft as a pat on the hand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは私の描けるスケッチを褒めて下さった
lines.en: Dear, when I was young, my father praised the sketches I could draw.
lines.style: Warmer here, a faint smile in the voice; slight catch on the remembered praise.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、リンゴをむいて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when we were young, you would peel apples for me, wouldn't you, dear?
lines.style: Hushed and intimate; slowing on the apple memory, ending with a fond little lilt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが夏目漱石の全集を蔵書された
lines.en: Dear, when I was young, my father kept the complete works of Natsume Soseki in his library.
lines.style: Reverent, bookish savor on the author's name; unhurried, recalling the collection shelf by shelf.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、偶像、つまり偶像崇拝を戒められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you always cautioned against idols — against idol worship, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Softly knowing close; careful weight on the warning, warmth folding over the final question.
